items.fullText: 핫픽! 미국주식 핫픽! 미국주식 젠슨 황 떠나자 반도체 '흔들'…한국 증시 영향은 입력 2026.11.16 14:32 수정 2026.11.16 14:36 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 박주연 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. AI 기사요약 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO 사임에 따른 AI 투자 위축 우려로 국내 증시 및 반도체 업종의 단기 변동성이 우려되나, 중장기적으로는 글로벌 경쟁 구도 재편과 대중 제재에 따른 경쟁 우위 유지로 한국 반도체 기업들에 반사이익 기회가 될 수 있다는 분석이 제기되었습니다. 사진=연합뉴스 젠슨 황 엔비디아 창업자가 최고경영자(CEO)에서 물러나면서 한국 증시도 당분간 흔들릴 수 있다는 분석이 나왔다. 엔비디아의 경영 공백이 인공지능(AI) 투자 위축 우려로 번지면 국내 반도체 대형주부터 타격을 받을 수 있어서다. 17일 하나증권은 보고서를 내고 이번 사태를 한국 증시에 단기 악재라고 진단했다. 반도체 대형주가 조정받으면 지수가 눌리고, 외국인 매도와 원화 약세가 겹치면 반도체 외 업종 주가도 압박받을 수 있다. AI 클라우드 업체의 자금 조달이 막혀 투자가 줄면 전력기기와 냉각, 건설 업종의 이익 전망도 다시 따져야 한다는 게 하나증권의 설명이다. 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. AI 포인트 뷰 이전 분석 종목 다음 분석 종목 본 서비스의 AI가 제공하는 종목 정보는 정보 제공 목적의 참고 자료일 뿐, 투자 권유·자문·추천에 해당하지 않습니다. 투자에 따른 손실 책임은 사용자에게 있습니다. 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 박주연 기자 증권부에서 운용사를 출입합니다. 기사댓글 개의 댓글이 있습니다. 댓글 닫기

items.fullText: 글로벌 시장 브리핑 국제 뉴스 픽 엔비디아 급락이 美국채시장까지 흔들었다…금리 5% 복귀 입력 2026.11.16 12:56 수정 2026.11.16 13:23 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 김동현 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. AI 기사요약 최근 미국 국채금리가 양호한 경제 지표보다 AI 관련 기술주의 급락에 민감하게 동조화되는 이례적인 현상이 나타났으며, 이는 AI 투자 위축이 경기 둔화로 이어질 수 있다는 우려와 안전자산 선호 심리가 채권시장에 선반영된 결과로 분석됩니다. 젠슨 황 전 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO). 사진=로이터연합뉴스 미국 인공지능(AI) 관련주 급락 이후 국채금리가 경제 지표보다 기술주 움직임에 민감하게 반응하는 이례적인 현상이 나타났다. AI 투자 열풍이 미국 경제 성장과 소비, 기업의 자본지출을 뒷받침하는 주요 동력으로 자리 잡으면서, 기술주 투자심리 변화가 채권시장까지 흔들고 있다는 분석이다. 13일 월스트리트저널(WSJ)에 따르면 미국 10년 만기 국채금리는 지난 10월 초부터 AI 관련주가 하락하는 과정에서 경제 성장률 전망 개선에도 큰 폭으로 떨어졌다. 통상 경제 지표가 예상보다 좋으면 미국중앙은행(Fed)의 금리 인하 기대가 약해지고 자금 수요 증가 전망이 반영되면서 국채 금리가 상승한다. 그러나 지난 한 달 동안 투자자들은 미국 경제의 성장세보다 AI 관련주 급락이 투자 포트폴리오에 미칠 영향을 더 중요하게 받아들였다. 국채 금리는 이번 주 예상보다 높은 물가상승률이 발표된 뒤에야 다시 5%를 넘어섰다. 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. items.fullText: AI Day Seoul Brings Together Korea’s Industry Leaders, Startups and Developer Communities November 15, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Over two days at COEX, more than 2,000 attendees converged for AI Day Seoul, bringing together Korea’s industry leaders, startups and developer communities advancing physical AI and AI agents. At the plenary sessions, Deepu Talla, vice president of robotics and edge AI at NVIDIA, said Korea is “punching above its weight,” with Doosan Robotics, Hyundai Motor Group, LG Electronics and SK Group — as well as startups like Real World and Luda Robotics — using NVIDIA platforms to bring general-purpose robotics into the real world. Jonathan Cohen, vice president of applied research at NVIDIA, showed how enterprises can build agents they own and control. Breakout sessions featured speakers from Coupang Intelligent Cloud, Doosan Robotics, LG AI Research, LG Electronics, NAVER Cloud, SK Telecom and Upstage. “It was a genuinely enjoyable time to have candid conversations,” said Hyunho Yang, research engineer for omnimodal foundation models at SK Telecom. “Seeing the passion of fellow AI developers was a real source of inspiration for me.” Community leaders share how they build with open models and tools at AI Day Seoul. The Agentic AI 10x Bootcamp Community Day brought together Pseudo Lab, Python Korea, PyTorchKR, HAERAE, Hugging Face KREW, Graph User Group, Womxn Who Code Korea, Dnol (Datayanolja) and other developer communities. Five finalists from the Hangul Day hackathon, co-hosted with Fastcampus, built agents trained on the Korean language and culture with the OpenShell runtime. The winning team, FlyGate, received an NVIDIA DGX Spark system. More than 500 developers also took part in full-day NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute workshops and NVIDIA Certification exams in Korean. items.d: "Jensen is Nvidia, right? And so much of this economy is riding on Nvidia."
items.fullText: We didn’t see this coming. Or at least, I didn’t — a week ago, when I wrote about Nvidia’s board opening an investigation into then-CEO Jensen Huang, I assumed his job was safe. On the latest episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast , Rebecca Bellan, Tim De Chant, and I discussed how Huang’s ouster went down and what it means for the larger AI economy. While Tim said he saw it coming (albeit not this quickly), Rebecca said, “I didn’t think it was going to happen at all.” “Jensen is Nvidia, right?” she added. “And so much of this economy is riding on Nvidia.” Similarly, I marveled at how quickly Huang’s support seemed to crumble, with more scandals seeming to emerge every day. (At the same time, there are many who’d still like to see him return .) And we also took a moment to wonder what will happen to Nvidia’s investments in the larger AI ecosystem. Keep reading for a preview of our conversation, edited for length and clarity; you can listen to the whole episode here . Tim De Chant: I figured this was coming. I didn’t think it would happen this quickly. I thought there would be at least a few days. Rebecca Bellan: I didn’t think it was going to happen at all. I mean, Jensen is Nvidia, right? And so much of this economy is riding on Nvidia. And we’ve got nothing but the last few years of data to show us that billionaires can do whatever the hell they want. So it was surprising to me — it almost restored my faith in humanity, that he resigned. But someone said to me, “If this were Elon, nothing would happen.” He would not be resigning. Nothing would be going down Anthony Ha: Which is interesting, because I would have said, as of a week ago, or even just a few days ago, that Jensen is in the same category as Elon. I mean, no one is quite as special as Elon is, but it’s a big, incredibly successful company. Like you said — in a lot of ways, the entire AI economy is built on top of Nvidia. items.t: TechCrunch Mobility: The Nvidia backup plan for China’s self-driving industry
items.d: Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility, your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, the role AI is playing in it.
items.fullText: Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility , your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, the role AI is playing in it. To get this in your inbox, sign up here for free — just click TechCrunch Mobility ! I am traveling through Portugal now that Web Summit has wrapped up, so please enjoy this shortened edition. Web Summit leaned heavily into Chinese founders and companies this year. The opening remarks from Web Summit co-founder Paddy Cosgrave drove the point home when he said the superstars of the future are coming from China, not California. He also gave a strong endorsement of China and open source technology when he noted that Chinese companies are building more of our shared future than anyone else. These remarks carried a different kind of weight just a few days later as the news spread throughout the conference that Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang had resigned from his leadership post after admitting to an affair with an alleged spy. The former CEO, after all, has been one of the strongest proponents for open source in the United States. And anyone who has followed the emergence of autonomous vehicle tech knows how central Nvidia is to that ecosystem. Nvidia is a major supplier of AI computing technology to the industry — although the degree of reliance varies. Some companies are using Nvidia’s automotive processors to run automated driving software, while others are using Nvidia GPUs to train autonomous driving models. And then there are the full-stack partnerships, which includes Mercedes-Benz, Zoox, and Wayve. I spoke to Leo Wang , the CFO of Chinese autonomous vehicle company Pony.ai , this week. I asked him about the challenges China’s self-driving industry faces and what he thinks will happen if the fallout from Huang’s resignation results in even stricter export controls on Nvidia chips shipped to China. items.t: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
items.d: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.
items.fullText: Outsiders had little reason to notice when Nvidia’s longtime chief security officer and head of product security stepped down in August. Just two and a half months later, CEO Jensen Huang himself left the company over growing questions about his extramarital relationships — starting with an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore data center company that U.S. investigators suspect of funneling Nvidia chips to China, then widening to reports about two separate affairs with Nvidia employees. At the time, David Reber, who spent four years as CSO and seven at Nvidia overall, said he was leaving for health reasons. “This wasn’t a pivot I had planned. But I know what needs to come first: family and health,” he wrote on LinkedIn in late August, disclosing that he’d been diagnosed with young-onset Parkinson’s more than two years ago. Reber’s replacement, Saša Zdjelar, previously spent 17 years at ExxonMobil in Houston, leaving as a senior IT manager before spending one year at Salesforce and several years at the cybersecurity company ReversingLabs. Zdjelar didn’t respond to questions Thursday about the transition or what the security team knew. Nothing public connects Reber’s or Zdjelar’s role changes to the Megaspeed matter, but it seems fair to wonder what Nvidia’s security team knew about the government’s scrutiny of Megaspeed and about Huang’s relationships, and whether anyone raised concerns. Reber didn’t respond to questions Thursday. Nvidia also has not answered our related questions. Relationships between a CEO and his employees typically fall to HR, legal and the board, not security. But security specialists say any affair — even one inside the office — can give a foreign intelligence service leverage over an exec who wants it kept quiet. Still, spotting the clues isn’t easy. items.t: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.d: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 1:41 PM PST · November 14, 2026 Image Credits: Li Hongbo/VCG / Getty Images Anthony Ha Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang A petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate the company’s recently ousted CEO Jensen Huang appears to have attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon. The petition website said the signers include 5,965 current Nvidia employees, 1,108 former employees, and 63,063 shareholders. Notable supporters include Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Replit CEO Amjad Masad, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan. The petition states that its signers are “concerned that Jensen was removed without meaningful due process” and demands that the board “bring him back while an independent investigation establishes the facts.” It also calls on the board to ensure a fair investigation and provide more information to the public. “Jensen deserves due process, not mob justice,” the petition says. Huang resigned on Thursday , four days after confessing to having an affair with a chip executive suspected by U.S. intelligence to be a Chinese spy. The former CEO has agreed to testify before Congress, while news reports have also suggested that Huang engaged in multiple extramarital affairs . Nvidia appointed CFO Colette Kress as the company’s interim CEO while it searches for a permanent replacement. Nvidia’s stock price fell sharply through the week, while Huang’s departure is also expected to leave a big gap in AI industry funding . items.t: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit
items.d: Some governments moved to confirm chip supply commitments, while others are monitoring the impact on local projects or addressing ongoing investigations.
items.fullText: Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia has drawn a range of responses across Asia, with some governments moving to confirm chip supply commitments, while others are monitoring the impact on local projects or addressing ongoing investigations. On Sunday, November 8, Nvidia’s board launched an independent investigation after reports that Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy operation; Huang admitted to an affair with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based chip company Megaspeed. Nvidia’s influence extends far beyond the United States. The chip giant has built close ties with companies worldwide, particularly in Asia, where many of its key partners play important roles in the global AI industry. China China’s foreign ministry rejected allegations on November 10 that a Chinese businesswoman linked to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was a spy, calling them groundless and a smear against Beijing. On Friday , a spokesperson reiterated opposition to export controls that disrupt global supply chains and stated the ministry was not aware of reports linking restricted Nvidia chips to a Shanghai data center associated with Alice Huang. Huang’s exit has also raised uncertainty over more than $3 billion in Chinese AI computing projects reliant on Nvidia’s restricted processors, according to Reuters. Many of these chips are subject to U.S. export controls, making them difficult for Chinese companies to obtain. Singapore In Singapore, authorities seized the passport of Alice Huang, former CEO of Singapore-based cloud computing company Megaspeed, in June 2025 as part of an investigation into possible false declarations regarding server purchases, according to the Ministry of Home Affairs. The Singapore ministry said police took her passport to ensure she remained available for questioning, as she was not based in Singapore. items.t: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
items.d: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
items.fullText: It was the resignation heard across the world. Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s embattled CEO who co-founded and led the company for 33 years, had officially stepped down . “It’s like a bomb went off,” one neocloud founder told TechCrunch when he first heard the news. Over the last several years, Nvidia has been a prolific investor , pouring tens of billions into startups annually and participating in 105 rounds this year alone, often as the largest investor, according to PitchBook. “If that direction changes, it’ll be a big blow to so many young companies,” said Maria Davidson, founder of Relational Capital. Huang’s absence leaves the startup ecosystem without one of its biggest champions and with far less capital for now, investors say, which could have a massive impact on dealmaking, valuations, funding, and even competition. “Nvidia is carrying almost every AI-native startup from application to neocloud,” Dawn Capital’s Shamillah Bankiya told TechCrunch. Most of the significant decisions to invest in startups often came from Jensen himself, according to Umesh Padval, managing partner at Seligman Ventures. Padval has known Huang since serving on the board of Mellanox Technologies, a networking chipmaker Nvidia acquired for approximately $7 billion in 2020. While there is hope that Huang’s eventual successor will resume his dealmaking spree, investors aren’t hopeful that it will happen in the short term. Nvidia’s interim CEO, Colette Kress, is expected to institute some changes , especially when it comes to Nvidia’s investments into AI startups at the crux of the billion-dollar data center build-out . HBM을 쓰지 않는 AI칩으로 추론 시장을 공략하겠다는 구상이다. 2019년 설립된 디매트릭스는 추론용 반도체를 개발하는 스타트업이다. 추론은 학습을 마친 AI가 질문에 답하거나 작업을 수행하는 과정이다. 지난해 시리즈C 투자 유치 때 기업가치 20억달러(약 2조6700억원)를 인정받았다. SK하이닉스와 삼성이 각각 시리즈A, 시리즈B 투자에 참여했다. 세스 CEO는 "SK하이닉스도 장기적으로 추론에 새로운 메모리 구조가 필요하다는 문제의식에 공감했다"고 전했다. 다음은 세스 CEO와의 일문일답. 시드 세스 디매트릭스 최고경영자(CEO)가 지난 10일(현지시간) 미국 샌타클래라 본사에서 컵받침으로 차세대 반도체 '랩터' 구조를 설명하고 있다. 김인엽 특파원 ▷핵심 기술인 디지털 인메모리 컴퓨팅(DIMC)을 쉽게 설명해달라. “AI 추론의 핵심 문제는 데이터를 얼마나 효율적으로 가져오느냐다. 기존 구조에서는 계산하는 곳과 데이터를 저장하는 메모리가 떨어져 있다. 계산할 때마다 메모리에서 데이터를 가져와야 한다. 그 과정에서 시간과 에너지를 쓰고 비용도 발생한다. GPU와 고대역폭메모리(HBM)를 CoWoS 같은 첨단 패키징으로 연결하는 데도 많은 비용이 든다. 우리는 연산 기능과 메모리를 같은 실리콘 안에 결합했다. 계산에 필요한 데이터가 바로 가까이에 있도록 한 것이다. 데이터를 멀리 옮길 필요가 줄어드니 에너지를 덜 쓰고, 데이터를 가져오는 시간도 짧아진다. 비용 효율적인 패키징을 적용할 여지도 생긴다. 추론의 세 가지 문제인 속도, 에너지, 비용을 함께 풀겠다는 접근이다." ▷2019년 창업 당시에는 챗GPT도 없었다. 왜 추론에 베팅했나. “당시 클라우드 AI의 관심은 학습에 쏠려 있었다. GPU로 모델을 학습시키고, 추론은 GPU나 중앙처리장치(CPU)로 하면 된다는 생각이 일반적이었다. 추론 자체는 이미 감시카메라나 드론, 산업용 로봇 등에서 이뤄지고 있었다. 주로 영상을 처리하는 용도였다. 클라우드에서 대규모 추론을 실행하는 문제에 집중하는 곳은 드물었다. 우리는 사람의 삶을 떠올렸다. 사람은 학교와 대학에서 약 20년 동안 배운다. 기본 개념과 새로운 지식을 익히는 과정이다. AI에 비유하면 사전학습이다. 이후 40년은 배운 지식을 활용하며 살아간다. 지금 우리가 하는 일이 그렇다. 그것이 추론이다. 계속 배우고 개선하지만, 대부분의 시간에는 이미 배운 것을 적용한다. ▷세레브라스, 삼바노바, 그록 등 다른 추론 반도체 기업과 무엇이 다른가. “많은 경쟁사는 학습을 주요 용도로 출발했다가 추론 시장이 커지면서 방향을 바꿨다. 우리는 처음부터 추론을 위한 구조를 설계했다. 메모리와 연산을 결합하는 방식도 그 결과다. 또 하나는 칩렛이다. 거대한 칩 하나를 만드는 대신 작은 칩을 만들고 서로 연결한다. 고객이 필요로 하는 연산 규모에

items.t: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
items.d: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.
items.fullText: The leading open-weight models developed by Chinese companies were trained on Nvidia chips that the U.S. government restricted from shipping to its largest geopolitical rival, a new research effort claims. The apparently widespread access to Blackwell GPUs among Chinese frontier labs shows the magnitude of the problem facing the leading chip designer. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang left the company this week after admitting to his affair with Alice Huang, executive of Megaspeed, a company implicated in smuggling Nvidia chips into China. Alice Huang has also been alleged to be an agent of China’s intelligence service. While Jensen Huang’s relationships with a customer and two employees have drawn the most public interest, Nvidia’s potential corporate liability for export control violations likely factored into its decision to part ways with Huang. U.S. export controls are intended to protect the country’s leadership in AI capabilities against China, but Huang has long sought to open up that market. Blackwell GPUs are banned from export to China or Chinese-owned firms, while the Trump administration allows Nvidia to export the H200, a less powerful chip, provided shipments take a circuitous shipping route that allows the U.S. to claim a 25% tariff. Will DePue, a former OpenAI researcher who leads the nonprofit research group Unemployment Labs, analyzed the weights — the unique structure — of large language models released openly by DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Ant Group. The weights still reflect the configurations of the chips used to train them, and DePue was able to find compelling evidence that the most closely watched models, including Moonshot’s Kimi’s K3 releases and DeepSeek’s V4 models, bear fingerprints from training on Blackwell chips. items.fullText: BIO Insight 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 젠슨 황 스캔들에…엔비디아 '의료 AI 제국' 야심도 흔들리나 입력 2026.11.13 15:39 수정 2026.11.13 16:32 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 최지희 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 신약 개발서 수술로봇까지 플랫폼 확장 '헬스케어 수장' 파월 거취도 관심 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 사생활 논란 속에 사임하면서 엔비디아가 추진해 온 헬스케어 사업의 향방에도 관심이 쏠리고 있다. 황 전 CEO와의 부적절한 관계 의혹이 보도된 킴벌리 파월 헬스케어 부사장은 회사의 의료·생명과학 사업을 이끌어 온 핵심 인물이다. 그룹 CEO 교체에 헬스케어 책임자의 거취를 둘러싼 불확실성까지 겹치면서 의료 AI 사업의 지휘체계와 대외 협력 방향에도 변화가 생길 수 있다. 엔비디아는 12일(현지시간) 황 CEO의 사임과 콜레트 크레스 최고재무책임자(CFO)의 임시 CEO 선임을 발표했다. 앞서 뉴욕타임스가 황 전 CEO와 파월 부사장의 관계 의혹을 보도한 지 하루 만에 사임한 것이다. 엔비디아 헬스케어 사업은 ‘엔비디아 헬스케어’로 불리는 사업은 엔비디아가 의료·생명과학 산업을 대상으로 전개하는 하드웨어·소프트웨어 사업을 뜻한다. 직접 의약품을 판매하거나 병원을 운영하는 회사라기보다, 제약사와 의료기기 기업, 병원, 연구기관이 AI를 개발하고 활용하도록 그래픽처리장치(GPU)와 개발 플랫폼을 공급하는 역할이다. 사업 범위 또한 신약 개발, 유전체 분석, 의료영상, 의료기기·로봇, 디지털헬스 등으로 넓다. 연구실에서 신약 후보물질을 찾는 단계부터 병원에서 영상을 분석하고 의료기기를 가동하는 단계까지 의료산업의 여러 접점에 엔비디아 기술을 적용하는 구조다. 신약 개발 분야의 핵심은 ‘바이오네모(BioNeMo)’다. 연구자가 생물학 데이터를 학습하는 AI 모델을 구축하고, 분자를 설계하거나 단백질 구조와 결합을 예측하도록 지원한다. 유전체 분석 소프트웨어 ‘파라브릭스(Parabricks)’는 대규모 염기서열 데이터를 GPU로 처리해 유전적 변이를 분석하는 데 쓰인다. 의료영상에서는 오픈소스 개발 프레임워크 ‘모나이(MONAI)’가 중심축이다. 의료영상 AI 모델의 학습과 영상 분할·정합 등을 지원한다. 엔비디아는 "모나이가 누적 800만회 이상 다운로드됐고 4000개 이상의 프로젝트에 활용되고 있다"고 소개GOtEK. 의료기기와 로봇으로도 영역을 넓혔다. ‘홀로스캔(Holoscan)’은 영상·센서 데이터를 실시간으로 처리하는 기반을 제공하고, ‘아이작 포 헬스케어’는 의료로봇과 장비를 가상환경에서 설계·검증하도록 지원한다. 디지털헬스에서는 임상 연구와 의료진 업무를 보조하는 AI 에이전트 개발 도구를 제공하는 방식으로 사업을 키웠다. 릴리와 최대 10억 달러 공동투자 엔비디아 헬스케어 사업의 중요성은 협력 대상과 투자 규모에서도 드러난다. 엔비디아는 일라이릴리와 올해 1월 AI 공동혁신 연구소 설립을 발표하면서 향후 5년간 인력·인프라·컴퓨팅에 최대 10억 달러를 공동 투자하겠다고 밝혔다. 릴리의 생물학·의약학 전문가와 엔비디아의 AI 연구·엔지니어링 인력을 결합해 신약 개발을 가속한다는 구상이다. 의료기기 글로벌 1위 GE헬스케어와는 자율 영상진단 기술 개발에 나섰다. 양사는 지난해 3월 자율 엑스레이 기술과 초음파 애플리케이션 개발을 추진한다고 발표했다. GE헬스케어가 엔비디아의 시뮬레이션 플랫폼을 활용해 센서와 인체 구조, 의료환경 등을 가상으로 구현하는 방식이다. 임상개발&m

In the letters, Scott asked that Huang and Lutnick voluntarily appear before the Senate Banking Committee to testify Dec. 3 and Dec. 10, respectively. The longtime finance chief takes over as interim CEO following Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure, inheriting a company facing investor uncertainty, congressional scrutiny and questions about its future leadership. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Nvidia's Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress. NVIDIA via Reuters Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 12, 2026, 2:57 PM EST By Jane Lytvynenko For 13 years, Colette Kress helped manage the company’s transformation from a graphics-chip maker into the company at the center of the artificial intelligence boom. Now, she’s being asked to lead it through one of the most turbulent moments in its history. Kress, Nvidia’s chief financial officer, was named interim CEO Thursday following the abrupt resignation of Jensen Huang, who co-founded the company and led it for 33 years. Huang’s departure comes amid revelations of extramarital relationships with an alleged Chinese spy and one of his own reports. “We will continue advancing the work that has made Nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead,” Kress said in a press release. “Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders.” “I believe deeply in this company and in its future. More than anything, I believe in each of you, in our customers and partners and in the vital role we play every day in the global economy,” Kress said in an email to staff following her appointment, acknowledging the “extraordinarily difficult period” for the company. After diving as much as 16%, Nvidia’s stock ended the day down by 4.3%, as the company and investors grappled with multiple scandals that have engulfed its co-founder and now-former CEO Jensen Huang. Throughout the day, the company was among the biggest decliners on the Nasdaq and S&P 500 indexes. It was the biggest decliner on the Dow. Without a formal succession plan, Nvidia, which designs the chips powering the entire AI sector, was thrust into crisis. It’s a pivotal moment for AI, with Anthropic gearing up for its potentially trillion-dollar-plus initial public offering next week. Anthropic is highly reliant on Nvidia’s chips and has entered into hundreds of billions of dollars worth of contracts with cloud providers to rent them. Nvidia named its longtime chief financial officer as its interim leader. Huang’s departure from Nvidia came after a New York Times report said the CEO had had a relationship with an executive at Nvidia who reports to him. That came right on the heels of his admission Sunday that he was “unfaithful” to his wife, an announcement that was released after the Financial Times reported Saturday that Huang had had a relationship with a businesswoman whom a source told NBC News was a Chinese spy. items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after affair with suspected Chinese spy Huang resigned after it was reported that he had a relationship with Alice Huang, a businesswoman who is accused of being a Chinese agent, and also engaged in a relationship with an Nvidia executive. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 The rise and fall of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 03:09 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 12, 2026, 8:53 AM EST / Updated Nov. 12, 2026, 9:21 PM EST By Rob Wile , Steve Kopack and Brian Cheung Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships, including one with a suspected agent of China and another with an executive who reported to him — a stunning turn of events for the head of a company at the heart of the global AI investment boom. Colette Kress, the company’s chief financial officer, will become interim CEO, Nvidia’s board said in a statement. Nvidia shares plunged more as much as 16% after the board’s announcement, before later recovering and closing lower by 4.3%. A company spokesperson clarified that Huang will not be working with Nvidia in any capacity going forward. The company also named its first chairman. That role will be filled by Harvey Jones, who is a former CEO of major chip company Synopsys. The addition of a chairman is a major governance overhaul at a company that for decades relied solely on Huang. Nvidia’s board met Wednesday night to address Huang’s future at the company, a source familiar with the matter told NBC News, adding that the White House was aware of the meeting. Huang, 63, co-founded Nvidia in the early 1990s and led the company’s meteoric rise amid the AI boom of the past several years. items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Contribution and New AI Infrastructure At KubeCon, NVIDIA is putting tools to secure agents and run AI on Kubernetes in the hands of the cloud-native community. November 10, 2026 by Warren Barkley 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Kubernetes, the open source system that manages how applications run across thousands of AI factories, has become the foundation for AI, and the demands on it are only growing. To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities. NVIDIA is contributing NVIDIA OpenShell , an open source runtime for securing and governing autonomous agents, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), a nonprofit that is part of the Linux Foundation and the host of KubeCon. As a CNCF Sandbox project, OpenShell will be governed by the organizations building it into their products and strengthened by the expertise of security professionals worldwide. NVIDIA is also contributing to Agent Substrate , an open source Google-led framework for operating long-running agent workloads at scale on Kubernetes that has been accepted into the CNCF Sandbox. Additionally, NVIDIA announced new components of the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform : NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine , NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes and NVIDIA Snapshot . These tools help teams deploy, manage and scale GPU infrastructure on Kubernetes for AI factories. Together, these advancements mark a step forward in making Kubernetes the leading foundation for AI workloads at scale — empowering developers to build safer, more efficient AI infrastructure for the future.
